name: Zenobia Giz Mauzes
original_name: ゼノビア.ジス.マウゼス
source:
A knight of the Ishgalia court who serves Demetrio Madram.

[Spoiler] Younger sister of the Hero Executor Krayle, Zenobia understood her brother's twisted nature better than anyone else. News of his mysterious demise in Ishgalia compelled her to join the Church hierarchy and attain the rank of paladin so that she might find out the truth about her brother's death. Eventually she discovered Madram's secret Chimera alchemical laboratory but was caught in his trap and eventually brainwashed via a summoned demon to serve directly under Madram as his personal assassin and executioner.

Highly skilled in combat, she is capable of fighting evenly against Claudia when Orias and his party cross swords against her. [/Spoiler]
